# LayoutWidget { #anylumino.LayoutWidget }

```python
LayoutWidget()
```

Base class for keyed anywidget composition layouts.

``LayoutWidget`` stores child widgets in a keyed map while syncing the
frontend-ready widget views to the browser. Subclasses choose the Lumino
layout that displays those children.

| Name | Description |

| [child_min_height](#anylumino.LayoutWidget.child_min_height) | A trait for unicode strings. |
| [child_min_width](#anylumino.LayoutWidget.child_min_width) | A trait for unicode strings. |
| [fit_content](#anylumino.LayoutWidget.fit_content) | A boolean (True, False) trait. |
| [height](#anylumino.LayoutWidget.height) | A trait for unicode strings. |

| [scroll_y](#anylumino.LayoutWidget.scroll_y) | A boolean (True, False) trait. |
| [titles](#anylumino.LayoutWidget.titles) | An instance of a Python list. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [move_widget](#anylumino.LayoutWidget.move_widget) | Move a child to a new position, keeping keys and titles aligned. |
| [remove_widget](#anylumino.LayoutWidget.remove_widget) | Remove a child and return the owner that was passed in. |

### move_widget { #anylumino.LayoutWidget.move_widget }

```python
move_widget(key_or_index, index)
```

Move a child to a new position, keeping keys and titles aligned.

### remove_widget { #anylumino.LayoutWidget.remove_widget }

```python
remove_widget(key_or_index, *, close=False)
```

Remove a child and return the owner that was passed in.

Pass ``close=True`` to also close the removed widget models. Closing
releases them from the ipywidgets registry and makes them unusable, so
the default keeps the returned owner alive for the caller to reuse.
